images.limitations: 封面经过模型重绘，强指间穿插尚不足；精确交付须使用真实封面和独立文字图层。

minimum_visual_signature: Thin dark translucent LANDSCAPE music cards in an irregular fan from the actual near hand, with varied scale/tilt/depth. Main side cards and smaller receding cards, not a flat symmetric grid. Album cover, exact metadata and controls share a projective plane; original fingers and palm obscure chosen card portions. Real cover assets must be distinguished from model redraws.
